# Sizing results (generated by tools/dcdc_calc.py)

Topology assumed: isolated full-bridge, center-tapped secondary, 14.0 V out, 500 W, 100 kHz.
Change defaults in the script (vout, pout, fsw) and re-run.

| Parameter | Leaf 2022 pack (96S, 288-403 V envelope) | Original 96 V bench/low-voltage profile (82-110 V) |
|---|---|---|
| Input range (V) | 288-403 | 82-110 |
| Output | 14.0 V / 35.7 A / 500 W | 14.0 V / 35.7 A / 500 W |
| Turns ratio Np:Ns:Ns | 16:1:1 | 4:1:1 |
| Effective duty at Vin_min / Vin_max | 0.79 / 0.57 | 0.70 / 0.52 |
| Output inductor (min, 30% ripple) | 2.9 uH, rated >= 46 A | 3.2 uH, rated >= 46 A |
| Output cap (ripple only) | 134 uF min (ESR dominates) | 134 uF min (ESR dominates) |
| Primary RMS current (approx) | 2.2 A | 8.2 A |
| Secondary RMS per winding | 25.3 A | 25.3 A |
| Primary FET Vds rating (x1.3) | >= 524 V | >= 143 V |
| Secondary FET Vds rating (x1.3) | >= 65 V | >= 72 V |

Notes: duty is limited to 0.8 at minimum input; 0.3 V allowance for secondary drops; no resonant/ZVS tuning, leakage inductance or thermal derating included.
